corrections: Source variables strips validated i/u-width and Boolean console carrier prefixes for native decimal and true/false display; raw console provenance is retained.
Direct scalar Watch display consumes the validated copied display instead of assuming the integer prefix still exists.
Genuine before controls show all 22 integer/Boolean argument Watch paths already worked at O0. Do not claim a newly fixed Watch-evaluation engine for those parameters.
The direct object integer display branch is bounded detached formatter support. These new 22 live arguments primarily exercise source-stop numeric carriers, not a newly qualified object-integer ABI.
The full O1 matrix failed genuine Boolean locations after 20 correct integer carriers: DWARF4 emits Wasm local; constu1; and; stack_value.

DWARF5 emits Wasm local; convert CU-base-DIE; convert CU-base-DIE; stack_value. Both genuine Clang21 conversion DIEs have DW_AT_byte_size=1 and no DW_AT_bit_size. Names unsigned_1/unsigned_8 are not semantic widths.

The finite decoder permits at most four local-only integer transforms; unsigned converts resolve exact current-CU DW_TAG_base_type, encoding, storage width and optional explicit bit width. Unsupported signed/float conversions remain unavailable.

Transform operations run only on the actual initialized copied i32/i64 carrier, before source-width truncation. No expression stack, host register, dereference, guest function execution or memory/frame-base capability is added.
Existing numeric DATA test initialization now assigns type fields by name instead of relying on obsolete aggregate layout.
The Linux credential-window unit uses a short owner-private /tmp socket path under a deeply nested guarded TMPDIR; the actual authentication race assertions and cleanup remain intact.
limitations: Fresh full products contain the R51 frozen source plus the owned R53 three-header C++ delta and the historical separately pinned LLVM23 developer provider. Current local peer source edits and the latest ROS provider are not qualified.
The new primitive live matrix is C/C++/Objective-C/Objective-C++ only, Wasm32/64, DWARF4/5, O0/O1. Primitive OC frontend metadata does not qualify Foundation or dynamic ObjC objects.
Rust/TinyGo/Zig and floating controls validate their existing finite routes, not every language ABI or all native-debugger operations.

QEMU qualifies the copied-value DATA path on 16 actual target ELFs per repository, including native x86 reference and BE/LE masks; it does not qualify full target VM/JIT/DAP, hardware or native language runtime debugging.
Conversion-to-generic, signed/float conversions, transformed piece expressions, general arithmetic/branching and memory operations remain outside this finite new profile.
No display label, type DIE, transform result or location plan becomes read/write, expansion, callable, address or VM-debugging authority.
